title: Hypercone Visualizer
summary: A browser-based visualization of a cosmological hypercone, preserved as a lightweight case study with an opt-in Unity WebGL demo.
description: The visualizer pairs a static portfolio shell with a separately hosted Unity build, allowing the site to stay fast while the interactive experience remains directly accessible.
challenge: Present a large WebGL experiment without making a roughly 42 MB application part of the initial portfolio page load.
decisions: Keep the HTML shell in the website repository
Host versioned build binaries on assets.metater.net
Require explicit launch before iframe creation
outcomes: The legacy URL remains functional on both hosting origins
The main portfolio transfers no Unity code before launch
The demo supports fullscreen and a separate-tab fallback

demo.fallbackDescription: A static description of the visualization remains available in this case study if the interactive build is not launched.
